title: The Stars Hung above the Table
youtube_title: The Stars Hung above the Table | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a paper stars hung so they did not bump heads will go wrong if one person rushes. Zola and Greta split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
